_blocked: BLOCKED: GenericEmulatorPlugin drives BizHawk with the generic Lua connector. This world speaks SNI. Building it would produce a plugin that installs, launches an emulator, and never connects. See catalog/GROUP_SNES.md.
_note: The AP game name is 'Lufia II Ancient Cave', NOT the game's retail title: the world randomises the Ancient Cave mode specifically. Using the retail name in a YAML would produce a slot the server does not know.
